minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  July 8, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:33 a.m.:

  Members Present: Peggy Velasquez, City Treasurer
  Kenneth Campos, City Attorney
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk
  Maria Heaney, Revenue Manager

  Staff Present:  Jose Cortes, Human Resources
  Jenny Hsieh, City Attorney’s Office

1. The minutes of July 01, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Monjaras & Wismeyer Group, Inc. - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the
  recommended settlement payment of $1,942.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Closed Session- Confidential
  Luis Martin vs City of Inglewood- A motion was moved and second to recommend
  settlement payment of $2,000.00.

4. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:55 a.m.

Adjournment
